context_requirements: Functional renin-angiotensin system with endogenous angiotensin II signaling
Cell types with high ACE expression (endothelial, renal, cardiac, pulmonary epithelium)
Presence of bradykinin signaling components for ACE-inhibitor-mediated bradykinin effects
Absence of the above in the nine tested cancer cell lines makes transcriptional response unlikely
falsifiers: Reproducible, dose-dependent changes in landmark gene expression at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine cell lines
Consistent upregulation of ACE2 or downregulation of ACE across multiple lines
Induction of a generic stress, apoptosis, or proliferation program at 24 h in multiple lines

evidence.supports: ACE inhibition reduces MMP-2 and MMP-9 expression/activity in a rat heart failure model, but this is an in vivo tissue-remodeling effect, not a direct transcriptional response in cancer cell lines.
ACE inhibitor enalapril affects vascular apoptosis in hypertensive rats, indicating in vivo vascular effects rather than direct cancer cell line transcription.
ACE inhibitor perindopril reduces apoptosis and oxidative stress in THP-1 macrophages stimulated with SARS-CoV-2 spike protein, showing context-dependent anti-inflammatory effects in immune cells.
ACE inhibitor-related cough is associated with bradykinin B2 receptor polymorphism, a host genetic effect not expected in the tested cell lines.
ACE inhibitor temocapril prevents aortic dissection and VSMC apoptosis in rats, an in vivo vascular effect not directly relevant to the nine cancer cell lines.
